name: Saint Nicholas
history: Bishop of Myra in Asia Minor, remembered for secretly giving three bags of gold to save three poor girls from ruin by throwing them through a window at night. From that hidden charity came Santa Claus.
life: Nicholas was bishop of Myra in Lycia, on the south coast of present-day Turkey, in the fourth century. Few facts about him are certain, but his cult was strong in East and West from early times. Tradition says he was born at Patara to wealthy Christian parents, gave away his inheritance, suffered imprisonment in the persecution under Diocletian and attended the Council of Nicaea. Other stories tell how he saved three innocent men from execution and calmed a storm for sailors. In 1087 sailors from Bari carried his relics from Myra to their own city, where they rest in the Basilica of San Nicola. He is the patron of children, sailors and Russia. The Dutch kept his feast with gifts for children as Sinterklaas, and from that custom came Santa Claus.
prayerTo: Saint Nicholas, generous shepherd, you gave in secret to save the poor from shame and despair. Pray for children, for families in need, and for all who travel by sea. Teach me to give without being seen, and to prepare for Christmas with a heart turned towards others. Amen.
penance: Give a gift anonymously today to someone in need, and give a child a small present or treat in honour of Saint Nicholas.
prayer: O God, You who made the holy Bishop Nicholas renowned for countless miracles, grant, we beseech You, that by his merits and prayers we may be saved from the fires of hell. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
prayerSource: Collect of the day, Roman Missal of 1962
